shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo REANCHOR_PRESENT; fi && cat package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec anchor|SPEC\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80 && rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -30 && sed -n '1,240p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && git show --stat --oneline HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names -- --fix && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts::names the full path of a nested missing required property"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand --coverage=false -t '"'^ToolRegistry input validation names the full path of a nested missing required property$'"'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Repair registry test lint findings" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
